name: Precise
reducedMotionPolicy: No travel, scale or pulse; fades capped at 80ms; direct input stays immediate

categories.name: Controls
categories.owners: Qt Widgets style engines; Qt Quick switches, buttons and focus states
categories.rule: Small, frequent feedback. Change color or position quickly; press feedback takes half the entry time.

categories.name: Dock & launch
categories.rule: One restrained lift for hover and one pulse for launch. No perpetual bounce; a running app keeps a static indicator.

categories.examples: Go menu · tray · calendar · confirmation · notification entry
categories.name: Menus & popups
categories.owners: Plasma popups; application QMenus; tray and Start menu surfaces
categories.rule: Reveal from the source with a small translation and fade. Exit is shorter than entry. Notification dwell time is separate.

categories.examples: Settings pages · tabs · Start menu categories
categories.name: In-app navigation
categories.owners: Start menu StackView; settings navigation; application page transitions
categories.rule: Keep direction meaningful and retain context. Use a smooth start and stop. Pointer-driven scrolling stays direct.

categories.name: Windows
categories.owners: KWin window effects; separate from application content animations
categories.rule: Larger surfaces need time to settle. Scale gently for open/close; reserve travel to a destination for minimize/restore.

categories.name: Workspace & session
categories.owners: KWin desktop and Overview effects; lock-screen and splash QML
categories.rule: Large context changes are the slowest family. Desktop changes are directional; session changes crossfade. Authentication never waits for animation.

categories.examples: Success cue · app needs attention · validation feedback
categories.name: Status & attention
categories.owners: Dock attention; inline status; notification and validation cues
categories.rule: One finite pulse, then a persistent icon or label. Busy indicators and real progress follow the operation, not these transition timings.

scope: preview candidate; no system settings applied
